Autodesk Maya USD NURBS curve test asset

test/testSamples/basisCurves/nurbsCircleExport.usda from Autodesk/maya-usd
at commit 48eae123cabec8e671f0779b03c22fa30631a781. Only the corpus filename
has changed; the original layer, points, knots, transforms, metadata and
widths remain byte for byte unchanged.
